ModMetaData.name: Essencebound v0.19 — RimWorld 1.7
ModMetaData.author: Essencebound Project
ModMetaData.description: Essencebound v0.19: all 100 planned Essencebound abilities now have gameplay implementations. Adds thirty more powers including familiar summons, gravity wells, reaction wards, combat combos, regeneration sanctuaries and channeled teleportation. Requires Harmony. Experimental RimWorld 1.7 mod; verify in a test save.
